title: MNIST MLP Inference Debugger
approval: User authorized self-review without asking for approval.
approvedRefinements: Canonical shared frame, two-line Reference seven/Hand-drawn and Blank/Zero brightness buttons (remove invented third button), range controls, summaries/progress/Guide invitation.
Immediate prediction selection; mutually exclusive answers distinguish possible biased/nonuniform scores from mandatory uniformity or inability to compute, removing overlapping raster alternatives.
Real loaded model/runtime metadata only; no fake fallback architecture or probabilities before current inference.
Actual model input/trace/bar lengths and score gradients supersede raster arithmetic.
Primary compact input/probability comparison; selected neuron reconciliation and optional network/matrix/saliency retain original debugging scope.
All pixels/layers/neurons keyboard editable; signed evidence and exact data supply color-independent equivalents.
One Guide invitation with canonical behavior; remove invented promises about hints/answers and Start discussion button.
Four-decimal brightness editor preserves the supersampled fixture on blur; native pointer focus prevents scrolling. Controlled matrix disclosure survives input reruns.
